scope: Explicit reconstruction and refinement of a selected relational law; no claim of unique rule selection, physical energy, or emergent matter.

coupled_raw_refinement.scope: Fine initial links lie in the embedded coarse subgroup, not the full-fiber uniform ensemble.

stationary_shared_link_runs.initial_measure: Independent uniform raw links; exactly stationary mixture of conserved sectors, not an equilibration claim.
stationary_shared_link_runs.scheduler: Uniformly choose one fan and one of 15 channels: vacancy/Hurwitz/inverse-Hurwitz on the first two based loops, or one of twelve relational reactions.
stationary_shared_link_runs.clock_scope: All proposals, including idle ones. Channel layout is this generic fan experiment, not claimed identical to the compiled triangle pair-support scheduler.
